title: Vital Edge
description: Screen-edge armor durability gradient — ambient, HUD-free, client-side.
body:
# Vital Edge

Vital Edge renders a subtle 4-edge screen gradient that reflects your armor's durability — no HUD text, no icons, no new items. Just ambient color at the edges of your screen.

## How it works

The overlay color shifts based on your equipped armor's aggregate durability:

| Durability | Color |
|---|---|
| 70–100% | Green |
| 40–69% | Amber |
| 15–39% | Orange |
| 5–14% | Red |
| <5% | Pulsing red (shore wave) |

- **No armor equipped** → overlay off entirely
- **Partial armor** → calculated from equipped slots only
- **Damage surge** → heartbeat pulse on taking damage
- **Biome blend** → subtle hue shift based on your current biome
- **Y-height modifier** → brightens above Y=0, darkens below

## Configuration (Mod Menu)

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| Overlay | Toggle on/off |
| Edge Thickness | How far the gradient bleeds inward (3–8%) |
| Steps | Number of gradient bands (8–20) |
| Gradient Style | Stepped (blocky) or Smooth (exponential fade) |
| Opacity | Master transparency (0–50%) |
| Damage Surge | Toggle heartbeat pulse on damage |
| Biome Blend | Toggle biome hue tinting |
| Blend Strength | Biome tint intensity (0–100%) |

Settings persist across sessions.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.16.0
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu (optional, for configuration)

## Compatibility

- Client-side only — no server install required
- Compatible with Iris + Sodium
- Compatible with other HUD mods

## Roadmap

v1.1 will extend compatibility to Minecraft 1.21.1–1.21.11 with no new features.
